paite: Huchi in kumpipa leh Haman kumpinu Esther toh an nekna ah ahong uhi.
Uain adawn lai un ani nih ni in kumpipa'n Esther kiang ah, "Bang ahia na thumna, kumpinu Esther? Ahon phalsak ding uh bang ahia na ngetna? Gam kimkhat leng piak in na om ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Esther kumpinu'n adawng a, "Aw kumpipa, na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tan a, kumpipa kipahna ahihleh, ka thumna ah ka hinna leh ka mite hinna piak in om hen:

Zuak in ka omta ua, kei leh ka mite, hihgawp a om ding in, thah a om ding in leh hihmang ding in. Sikhapa ding leh sikhanu ding a zuak a om hi le ung zaw, melma in kumpipa siatna gun bawl theita kei mahleh, dai dide ding hi veng in " achi hi.
Kumpipa Ahasueras in thu agen a, kumpinu Esther kiang ah, "Kua ahia, koi a om ahia, huchibang a lungtang sung a tum ngam?" achi hi.
Esther in, "Melma leh gal, hiai giloupa Haman mah," achi hi. Huchi in kumpipa leh kumpinu ma ah Haman alauta hi.

Huchi in uain dawnkhamna a kipan aheh ziak in kumpipa adingkhia a, inpi huansung ah alut a; huchi in kumpinu Esther kiang a ahinna ngen ding in Haman adingh hi; kumpipa'n asiatna ding in hoih lou a tup a-om chih lah athei ngal a.

Kumpipa Kulhpi huan a kipan uain an nekna mun ah ahong kik a; huchi in Esther omna tutphah nem tung ah Haman apuk hi. Kumpipa'n, "Inn sung a ka ma a kumpinu nangawn sual ding ahi hia?" achi hi. Kumpipa kam a thupawt bang in, Haman maitang atuamsakta uhi.

Huai lai in kumpipa ma a om zel michilgehte lak a khat, Harbonah in, "En un, Haman in Mordekai, kumpipa gum a thugenpa a dia abawl, khailupna khuam tong sawmnga a sang, Haman inn ah adingh hi," achi hi. Huan kumpipa'n, "Huai ah amah khailum un," achi hi.
Huchi in Mordekai a dia abawlkholhsak khailupna khuam ah Haman akhailumta uhi. Huchi in kumpipa thangpaihna adaita hi.
